'''Version 1.2.0''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on October 23rd 2019.  It was 499.12 KB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

* Added more options to the config file
* Fixed some typos in the config file
* Added animations for Mob: [[Heavy Carrier|Rathol]]
* [[Assimilated Big Spider|Dorpa]] mob is now a bit smaller
* Removed the custom spawn eggs from the creative tab
* Changed base values of some mobs for balancing purposes
* Added 3 mobs:
*# [[Flying Carrier|'''Buthol''']]: Flying mob, unknown origin
*# '''Infected Alafha''': Flying mob, unknown origin
*# [[Primitive Reeker|'''Nogla''']]: Ground mob, unknown origin
